error.title: Could not open local database (IndexedDB).
error.hint: Try a normal (non-private) window, allow site data for localhost, or clear site data and reload.

drawFarm.instruction: Tap the map to trace the boundary (3+ points). <0>Enter</0> finishes, <1>Esc</1> cancels.

toasts.addThreeCorners: Add at least 3 corners to close a farm boundary.
toasts.outlineNoArea: That outline has no area. Adjust the points and try again.
toasts.gridFilled: Filled farm — {plants} plants in {rows} rows ({rowMode}, bearing {bearing}°).
toasts.searchNoPlaces: No places found — try another wording.
toasts.geoUnavailable: Geolocation is not available in this browser.
toasts.farmDeleted: Deleted "{name}" and all of its plants, rows, and valves.

dialogs.deleteFarmBody: <bold>{{name}}</bold> and everything inside it — plants, rows, valves, irrigation logs, and disease history — will be permanently removed from this device. This can't be undone.
dialogs.renameFarmDescription: Update the display name stored with this farm on your device.
dialogs.newFarmDescription: Choose a label for this boundary. You can change it later from the farm menu.
